query: get the JSON out of an LLM reply wrapped in markdown fences
note: extract_json_from_stream (added, outside pool) takes an iterable of text chunks and prefers fenced markdown output; passing [reply_text] satisfies the need, so labelled relevant but borderline. Private _last_json_span and _MultiModelStream.feed judged not relevant (private internals behind the public functions).

query: work out the dollar cost of a request from token counts
note: get_model_cost only returns per-token price, does not compute a dollar cost, so not relevant.

query: list the links referenced in a markdown document
note: Both extract markdown links but only internal ones (external, mailto and anchors skipped); labelled relevant with that caveat. make_sitemap version also rewrites paths to .md/index.md, so it is the more adapted of the two.

query: check if a callable is async, even through decorators or partials
convert a TypedDict class into a pydantic model
note: _typed_dict_to_model is private but is exactly the converter. prepare_response_model also converts TypedDicts but as one step of a much broader normalisation that returns a wrapped runtime model; judged not relevant. is_typed_dict only detects.

query: tell whether a partially streamed payload is finished and parseable
note: JsonCompleteness.analyze/is_root_complete can answer it too but need a two-step stateful call and report per-path completeness; judged not relevant.

query: strip invisible characters that break parsing of streamed text
note: remove_control_chars is the direct answer. _JsonControlCharSanitizer.__call__ is a private stateful per-chunk sanitiser (also drops DEL/C1 outside strings), labelled relevant but borderline as a private class. scripts/make_clean.clean_markdown_content strips zero-width chars but is a markdown doc cleaner, not for streamed JSON; not relevant.

query: join back-to-back chat turns from the same speaker
deterministic fingerprint for deduplicating identical LLM requests
note: Both hash a request into a deterministic SHA-256 key; make_request_cache_key hashes the full prepared request, make_cache_key the main components. client_cache_identity only builds an identity dict; not relevant.

query: download a remote file without allowing requests to internal hosts
note: Image.url_to_base64 is a thin image-only wrapper returning base64; judged not relevant for a generic file download (borderline). _validate_public_url/_request_with_redirects are private building blocks.

query: guess whether a path or link is a picture, audio, or document
note: Per-type autodetect_safely methods (Image/Audio/PDF) only test one type; not relevant.

query: disallow undeclared keys everywhere in a JSON schema
note: core.schema.make_strict_schema is a thin wrapper around the openai one; calling it does the job so labelled relevant (both were in the pool). Bedrock _prepare_bedrock_strict_schema also sets additionalProperties=false recursively but is private, takes a model, and rejects many constraints; not relevant.

query: read the YAML header block at the top of a markdown page
note: Hand-rolled regex extractor that returns only title/description/keywords, not the whole header; labelled relevant but borderline.

query: locate roughly where a quoted sentence appears in a passage
note: CitationMixin._get_span is a private method but is the fuzzy quote locator. get_spans needs an instance carrying substring_quotes; judged not relevant.

query: fill in placeholder variables inside prompt messages
note: None of the three relevant functions were in the pool (found by reading core/templating.py; pool only had per-provider helpers). apply_template (Jinja render of a string), process_message (one message, any provider format) and handle_templating (all messages in request kwargs) all satisfy it. Per-provider process_message helpers (openai/anthropic/gemini/cohere/genai/vertexai templating.py) and render_text_blocks handle one format and need the renderer passed in; judged not relevant (borderline).

query: write output to a temporary file then swap it into place
note: _atomic_result_file is private but is a generic context manager for exactly this; labelled relevant.

query: running total of tokens consumed over repeated model calls
note: Anthropic-only update_total_usage accumulates and is labelled relevant (borderline, one provider); _accumulate_models is the private generic accumulator, not relevant.

query: estimate how many tokens a prompt will consume before sending
note: Checked by grep and by reading the pool: no token estimation/tokenizer in indexed code. _usage_total_tokens only reads a total already on a usage object; calculate_cost needs token counts as input.

query: split a long document into overlapping chunks
note: Checked by grep: no text splitting/chunking helper for documents; all 'chunk' hits are about streaming response chunks.

query: compute cosine similarity between two embedding vectors
note: Checked by grep: no cosine similarity, dot product or embedding code in indexed code.
